1.name: Expertise
1.notes:
You gain Expertise in two of your skill proficiencies of your choice. Sleight of Hand and Stealth are recommended.
You gain Expertise in two additional skill proficiencies at level 6.

1.name: Sneak Attack
1.notes:
Once per turn, you can deal extra damage to a creature you hit with an attack roll if you have Advantage on the roll and the attack uses a Finesse or a Ranged weapon. The extra damage starts at 1d6 and increases with Rogue level as shown in the class table.
You do not need Advantage if an ally is within 5 feet of the target, the ally isn’t Incapacitated, and you don’t have Disadvantage.
The extra damage’s type matches the weapon’s damage type.

1.name: Thieves' Cant
1.notes: You learn Thieves' Cant and one additional language of your choice from the standard language tables.

1.name: Weapon Mastery
1.notes:
You can use the mastery properties of two kinds of weapons of your choice with which you have proficiency.
Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you may change which weapons you have mastery in (for example, switching from Daggers and Shortbows to Scimitars and Shortswords).

2.name: Cunning Action
2.notes: On your turn, you can take Dash, Disengage, or Hide as a Bonus Action.

3.name: Subclass Feature
3.notes:
You choose a Rogue subclass and gain its level 3 feature. Additional subclass features are gained at higher Rogue levels.

3.name: Steady Aim
3.notes: As a Bonus Action, you give yourself Advantage on your next attack roll this turn. You can use this only if you have not moved during the turn, and after using it your Speed becomes 0 until the turn ends.

4.name: Ability Score Improvement
4.notes: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat for which you qualify. You gain this feature again at levels 8, 10, 12, and 16.

5.name: Cunning Strike
5.notes:
When you deal Sneak Attack damage, you can apply a Cunning Strike effect by forgoing the listed number of Sneak Attack dice. Remove the die cost before rolling damage.
If an effect requires a saving throw, the DC equals 8 + your Dexterity modifier + your Proficiency Bonus.

Effects:
• Poison (Cost: 1d6): Target makes a Constitution save or becomes Poisoned for 1 minute. The target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. Requires a Poisoner’s Kit.
• Trip (Cost: 1d6): A Large or smaller target makes a Dexterity save or falls Prone.
• Withdraw (Cost: 1d6): Immediately after the attack, you move up to half your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

5.name: Uncanny Dodge
5.notes: When a creature you can see hits you with an attack roll, you can use your Reaction to halve the attack’s damage against you (round down).

6.name: Expertise
6.notes: You gain Expertise in two additional skill proficiencies of your choice.

7.name: Evasion
7.notes: When you make a Dexterity saving throw for half damage, you instead take no damage on a success and only half on a failure. You cannot use this feature while Incapacitated.

7.name: Reliable Talent
7.notes: When you make an ability check using a skill or tool proficiency, you treat a d20 roll of 9 or lower as a 10.

8.name: Ability Score Improvement
8.notes: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat for which you qualify.

9.name: Subclass Feature
9.notes:
You gain a level 9 feature from your Rogue subclass.

10.name: Ability Score Improvement
10.notes: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat for which you qualify.

11.name: Improved Cunning Strike
11.notes: When you deal Sneak Attack damage, you may use up to two Cunning Strike effects at once, paying each effect’s die cost.

12.name: Ability Score Improvement
12.notes: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat for which you qualify.

13.notes:

14.name: Devious Strikes
14.notes:
You gain new Cunning Strike options:

• Daze (Cost: 2d6): Target must make a Constitution save or, on its next turn, can take only one of the following: move, take an action, or take a Bonus Action.
• Knock Out (Cost: 6d6): Target makes a Constitution save or becomes Unconscious for 1 minute or until damaged. The target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns.
• Obscure (Cost: 3d6): Target makes a Dexterity save or becomes Blinded until the end of its next turn.

15.name: Slippery Mind
15.notes: You gain proficiency in Wisdom and Charisma saving throws.

16.name: Ability Score Improvement
16.notes: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat for which you qualify.

17.name: Subclass Feature
17.notes:
You gain a level 17 feature from your Rogue subclass.

18.name: Elusive
18.notes: Attack rolls cannot have Advantage against you unless you are Incapacitated.

19.name: Epic Boon
19.notes: You gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat for which you qualify. Boon of the Night Spirit is recommended.

20.name: Stroke of Luck
20.notes:
When you fail a d20 Test, you can turn the roll into a 20.
Once used, this feature cannot be used again until you finish a Short or Long Rest.
